invalid: The source response could not be verified.
failed: The source could not be read.
changed: Sources changed while browsing. Return to the first page to refresh.
accessRequired: Unlock the selected sources to retry this comparison.
statusUnavailable: Source status could not be checked: {message}
reviewUnavailable: Source changes could not be checked. The retained result is available; open it to check source access.
reviewUnchecked: Source changes have not been checked.
reviewChecked: Sources checked. No newer or unavailable inputs found.
reviewChanged: Newer or unavailable inputs: {count}. Review relevance; the retained result is unchanged.
reviewStale: This evidence changed. Refresh the list to check its current revision.
reviewFailed: Source changes could not be checked. Retry the check; the retained evidence is still available.
reviewCancelled: Source checking stopped. Unfinished checks remain unchecked.
reviewItems: Checking evidence sources: {completed} of {total} items reviewed.
reviewReferences: Checking evidence references: {count} examined. The total is not yet known.
reviewFinished: Source check results: {completed} of {total} items checked. See each item for its result.
overviewExtrasFailed: Unfinished work could not be loaded. The evidence list is still available.
